name: The Crimson Rebellion
_setNote: Introduced in Thunder's Edge — available whenever rules/gameMode.ts's own hasThundersEdge(gameMode) is true.

startingTechnologyChoice.note: Choose 1 red OR blue technology with no prerequisites (not a fixed list of specific tech ids — depends on which red/blue prerequisite-less techs exist in this game's tech deck).

factionAbilities.name: SUNDERED
factionAbilities.effect: You cannot use wormholes other than epsilon wormholes. Other players' units that move or are placed into your home system are destroyed.
factionAbilities.faq: Other factions CAN use epsilon wormholes themselves — but any of THEIR units that use one to travel INTO the Crimson Rebellion's home system are destroyed there per this same ability's own 2nd sentence.

factionAbilities.name: INCURSION
factionAbilities.effect: When you activate a system that contains a breach, you may flip that breach; systems that contain active breaches are adjacent. At the end of the status phase, any player with ships in a system that contains an active breach may remove that breach.

factionAbilities.name: THE SORROW
factionAbilities.effect: When you create the game board, place the Sorrow (tile 94) where your home system would normally be placed, then place an inactive breach there. The Sorrow is not a home system. Then, place your home system (tile 118) in your play area.
factionAbilities.note: Net setup effect: the Rebellion's REAL home system tile (118, Ahk Creuxx) starts off the board, in their play area — not adjacent to Mecatol Rex the normal way — while tile 94 ("the Sorrow", carrying an epsilon wormhole and starting inactive-breach) sits in the board position a home system would otherwise occupy. The Rebellion's own home system only becomes reachable via the breach/wormhole network this faction's other abilities manipulate.

versions.effect: Place this card faceup in your play area, and place the sever token in a system that contains your units; wormholes in that system have no effect during movement. Remove the sever token and return this card to the Rebellion player at the end of the status phase.

factionSpecificComponents.name: Active/Inactive Breach token
factionSpecificComponents.description: A double-sided token to mark active/inactive breaches for the Crimson Rebellion.

factionSpecificComponents.name: Sever Token
factionSpecificComponents.description: A token marking the closure of a wormhole through the Sever promissory note.

factionSpecificComponents.name: Sorrow (tile 94)
factionSpecificComponents.description: The tile placed where the Rebellion's home system would normally be — see THE SORROW faction ability. Contains an epsilon wormhole.

factionTechnologies.name: Subatomic Splicer
factionTechnologies.effect: When one of your ships is destroyed, you may produce a ship of the same type at a space dock in your home system.

destroyer.name: Exile
destroyer.note: Crimson Rebellion Destroyers interact with the Breach mechanic (placing inactive/active breach tokens after combat in or near this unit's system) and are stronger than regular destroyers. Capacity is 0 for both levels (source material lists it as "-", i.e. no capacity value).

abilities.name: Breach Placement
abilities.effect: At the end of any player's combat in this unit's system or an adjacent system, you may place 1 inactive breach in that system.

abilities.name: Breach Placement
abilities.effect: At the end of any player's combat in this unit's system or up to 2 systems away, you may place 1 active or inactive breach in that system.

breakthrough.name: Resonance Generator
breakthrough.effect: During your tactical actions, apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships that start in your home system or in a system that contains an active breach. ACTION: Exhaust this card to flip any breach or place an active breach in a non-home system that contains your units.
breakthrough.note: The Crimson Rebellion starts the game with their Breakthrough already unlocked — a Fracture roll (RR's own Breakthrough-unlock mechanic) is resolved during the "Gather Starting Components" step of setup, not triggered later like other factions' own Breakthroughs.
breakthrough.faq: Confirmed: yes, there is a Fracture roll at the start of any game with the Crimson Rebellion, specifically during the "Gather Starting Components" setup step, since that's when this faction GAINS its Breakthrough.

abilities.name: Breach Suppression Field
abilities.effect: While this unit is in a system that contains an active breach, other players' units in systems with active breaches lose all their unit abilities.

abilities.name: DEPLOY
abilities.effect: DEPLOY: During the "Commit Ground Forces" step of your tactical action in a system that contains an active breach, you may commit 1 mech, even if you have no units in the system.

agent.name: Ahk Ravin
agent.ability: ACTION: Exhaust this card to choose 1 player. That player may swap the position of 2 of their ships in any systems; they may transport units when they swap.
agent.faq: Not restricted to non-fighter ships — the ability doesn't say "non-fighter ship", so a fighter can be one of the 2 ships swapped.

commander.name: Ahk Siever
commander.unlock: Place a breach token in a system that contains another player's unit.
commander.ability: At the end of a combat between any players: Gain 1 commodity or convert 1 of your commodities to a trade good.

hero.name: Homesick Phantom
hero.effect: When you produce ships: You may place any of those ships on this card. At the start of a space combat, you may purge this card to place all ships from this card into the active system.
